slot.brief: Given a line by two points, find its direction cosines; direct formula with normalization — very easy.

stem: The direction cosines of the line directed from $A(1,2,3)$ to $B(4,6,3)$ are

verdicts.working: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=(3,4,0)\), with length \(5\). Thus the direction cosines are \((3/5,4/5,0)\).

working:
$\overrightarrow{AB}=(3,4,0)$, $|\overrightarrow{AB}|=5$
Direction cosines $=\left(\dfrac{3}{5},\dfrac{4}{5},0\right)$

Independent check: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=(3,4,0)\), with length \(5\). Thus the direction cosines are \((3/5,4/5,0)\).
